title: Persistent save and sync status
summary: For auto-save or background-sync workflows, show meaningful unsaved, saving, saved, and failed states without interrupting every success.
problem: Users cannot trust auto-save when there is no visible distinction between local edits, pending sync, successful persistence, and failure.
use_when: Edits save automatically or sync asynchronously
Closing or navigating before persistence could matter
avoid_when: Saving is a single explicit transaction with a clear submit and confirmation flow
rationale: Background persistence needs persistent state, not notification spam.
Failure should remain visible until resolved.

use_if: Edits save automatically or sync asynchronously
Closing or navigating before persistence could matter
prefer_alternatives_if: An explicit Save action with transactional confirmation is more appropriate

requirements: Expose status text to assistive technology without announcing every routine save excessively.
Keep errors persistent enough to discover and recover.
Differentiate unsaved, saving, saved, and failed.
Do not claim saved before durable persistence.
Connect offline state to pending sync.
